$comment: Upstream changes held back for the owner's decision by the weekly upstream sync (scripts/personal/upstream-sync.ps1). Each entry was reverted after the merge (holdBy=revert, revertCommit set) or kept on our side (holdBy=keep_ours). To ship one: git revert <revertCommit> (or undo the pin), then remove the entry.

held.whatChanged: Upstream moves node-pty from ^1.1.0 to 1.2.0-beta.15, only to get a linux-arm64 prebuild. Bots runs on Windows x64 and copies node-pty into each release, so it keeps ^1.1.0 (apps/server/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, our side of the 1.47.0 hand merge). No code in the batch needs the beta: NodePtyAdapter.ts is unchanged.
options: Keep node-pty ^1.1.0 (Windows x64 needs nothing from the beta)
Take 1.2.0-beta.15 after checking terminals on a staged release
held.recommendation: Keep ^1.1.0 until upstream ships a stable 1.2.x or merged code needs it.

$acceptedComment: Decisions the owner has already answered. A key listed here is settled: ship that upstream change like any other improvement, never hold it and never ask again. Remove an entry only if the owner changes his mind.
